## Elevant
The health model of the last hour first, then the SLOs of the last 30 days and the KPIs per month. Definitions and targets are in `docs/PRODUCT.md`; what to do when a flow is degraded is in `docs/OPERATIONS.md`.

content.title: Health model, last hour: degraded when p95 > 45 s or failures > 1 %, unhealthy when p95 > 60 s or failures > 5 %
SLOs, last 30 days: availability in business hours (SLO 99.7 %, SLA 99.5 %), draft p95 (SLO 45 s, SLA 60 s), failed drafts (SLO < 1 %)
content.query:
let availability = toscalar(requests | extend local = datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, "Europe/Madrid") | where dayofweek(local) between (1d .. 5d) and hourofday(local) between (7 .. 19) | summarize round(100.0 * countif(toint(resultCode) < 500) / count(), 3));
customEvents
| where name in ("quote_drafted", "quote_failed")
| summarize drafts = countif(name == "quote_drafted"), draft_p95_s = round(percentile(todouble(customDimensions.duration_ms), 95) / 1000, 1), failed_pct = round(100.0 * countif(name == "quote_failed") / count(), 2)
| extend availability_pct = availability

content.title: KPIs per month, within the 31 days the workspace keeps: KPI-1 median office time per quote (target 900 s or less), KPI-2 lines accepted unchanged (target 85 %), KPI-3 positive feedback (target 80 %)
Model tokens and cost per approved quote, last 30 days (cached input counted at the full price, so an upper bound; the full unit cost adds Cost Management, see docs/cost.md)
content.query:
let approved = toscalar(customEvents | where name == "quote_approved" | count);
dependencies
| where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "chat" and isnotempty(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"])
| summarize calls = count(), input = sum(tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"])), output = sum(tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]))
| extend approved = approved, model_eur = round((input * 0.22 + output * 1.7599) / 1e6, 4)
| extend eur_per_approved_quote = iff(approved > 0, round(model_eur / approved, 4), real(null))

content.title: KPI and SLI events arriving, last 7 days
content.query: customEvents | summarize events = count(), last = max(timestamp) by name | order by name asc
